I would like to thank Dr. Aleandri who accompanied us with professionalism and kindness for 13 years, with particular delicacy in the last period of our beloved furry friend.

I've been going to Dr. Aleandri for years now. It's hard to get a smile out of him, but he's an extremely competent professional who, beneath his professional exterior, hides an empathy I've seen in few.

Very helpful and calm doctor, I took my little one there to have the chip inserted and to do the booster vaccine, he made a great impression on me... I hope I need it as little as possible, but I think he's good.

Mr. Aleandri was incredibly helpful and kind with Astro as he prepared his travel certificate back to the United States. He made the process very easy and even helped me understand the government requirements for Astro’s export from Italy back home to the US. From what I could see, he has a long list of very loving clients in his neighborhood and beyond. Thank you Mr. Aleandri 😀🐶

After much searching for a veterinarian who performed tests such as an echocardiogram, I stumbled upon Dr. Aleandri. By calling the office, I was able to schedule an appointment for the same day.
A thorough, precise examination. We arrived at 7:30 PM and left the office after 9:00 PM. The doctor is a friendly person who loves his job, especially since he stayed well beyond office hours.
I highly recommend him.
I had an excellent experience with Dr. Aleandri due to his professionalism and humanity. I highly recommend him.
Professional, meticulous, and deeply empathetic with both patients and owners, he is incredibly dedicated to his little friends with an uncommon passion.
As always, a great professional. Always very thorough visits and very precise diagnoses.
